event_description: A user successfully signs in with password or Google authentication.
A user successfully creates an account with password or Google authentication.
An authenticated user successfully creates and explicitly saves a new form.
An authenticated user successfully creates a form from a business template.
The server successfully persists a response to a published form.
A user successfully generates an AI analysis for a form's records.
A user successfully receives an answer to an AI analysis question.
A user exports form records to a downloadable file.
A user successfully exports a report as a PDF.
